Cryptography

กิจกรรม Airdrop

A crypto portfolio event in which tokens are distributed, typically at no cost, to eligible wallet holders based on specific criteria or on-chain activity, used for user acquisition, governance distribution, or protocol incentives.

Definition

A crypto portfolio event in which tokens are distributed, typically at no cost, to eligible wallet holders based on specific criteria or on-chain activity, used for user acquisition, governance distribution, or protocol incentives.

Operational example

Crypto portfolio managers track airdrop events to capture new tokens for clients and ensure proper tax and compliance reporting.
